description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for functional testing of the OrangeHRM web application. It includes commands for login, API login, retrieving elements, displaying toast messages, setting values, validation checks, and selecting options within the UI.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login action by navigating to login page and submitting username and password.

methods.name: loginTo
methods.description: Performs login to a specified URL with given credentials, with optional additional options.

methods.name: apiLogin
methods.description: Performs API login via POST request to authenticate and validate credentials.

methods.name: getOXD
methods.description: Retrieves specific OXD elements based on type.

methods.name: getOXDInput
methods.description: Finds and returns input elements associated with a label, used for form interactions.

methods.name: toast
methods.description: Displays or checks for toast notification messages of a specified type.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a form input or textarea element.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if a form element displays an invalid message.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects an option within a dropdown or selection component.
